title: Technical Skill Upgradation Program for Construction & Industrial Workers
description: Led by technical instructors Sanjay Poudel (Civil Overseer), Shyam Shrestha (Electrical), and Krishna Lal Shrestha (Mechanical), Sangam Management Service offers skill enhancement for workers applying for overseas industrial jobs. The modules focus on blueprint reading, electrical wiring safety, mechanical maintenance, and site safety protocols to help workers pass employer skill verification tests.
